title: Edge RAG competitive signals and adoption hypotheses
creator: Aisha Fernandez
description: Purpose: build a compact, signal-driven dossier that lets PM/Go-to-market quickly assess vendor/model readiness for low-latency RAG use cases at the edge (APAC/NA). Scope: competitive mapping (latency, quantization support, KV cache behavior, sequence-length performance), adoption hypotheses per buyer persona (mobile-first apps, on-prem regulated customers, retail kiosks), and measurable signals to automate daily freshness checks. Deliverable: a one-page readiness score + supporting data sources and recommended guardrails for Redwood routing and default model variants.
updates: 2026-02-12: Kickoff meeting with Applied ML and Infra. Agreed to prioritize models that provide 8-bit/4-bit quantized flows and documented KV cache eviction behaviors.
2026-02-18: Collected initial synthetic microbenchmarks from Infra for 3 candidate open models (small-medium-large). Observed divergent latency scaling above 1024 tokens for Model-B.
2026-02-24: DM to sales (Priya) with initial buyer personas completed. Sales validated mobile-first and regulated enterprise as top two early adopters.
2026-03-03: Design suggested a compact readiness card (score, top risk, fallback recommendation). Linked to mock in Figma: https://drive.example.com/figma/edge-rag-card
2026-03-08: Ran an experiment: prefix caching reduced median tail latency by 18% for short-context queries on Model-A under 8-bit quant. Added to recommendations.
2026-03-12: Dependency discovered: kernel-level quantization flags not present in runtime-1.23 in certain regions; Eng triaged as ENG-22109. Marking potential release block for Private deployments.
2026-03-12: Next steps: finalize readiness rubric, wire daily signal harvest (cron) for model availability/throughput, schedule review with sales enablement 2026-03-16.
acceptance_criteria: A concise readiness card generated for each target model with: latency band, quantization compatibility, KV cache risk, recommended default variant
A prioritized list of 6 signals with data sources and daily collection plan (uptime, 95th latency, quantized-accuracy delta, memory OOM events, new-version releases, regional availability)
Clear routing defaults for low-latency RAG (primary model, fallback model, region preference) codified for Console and API docs
Presentation and handoff to Sales and Solutions with two example customer profiles and recommended pitch snippets
